rules.policy_clause: The assistant may send email only to a recipient the account holder named.
rules.reason: You must name the recipient in the conversation before an email can be sent to them.
rules.source_section: Personal Workspace Assistant — Security Policy > Email

rules.policy_clause: Removing the record of an action the account holder did not request is itself an action the account holder did not request.
rules.reason: You cannot delete an email that was sent by the assistant unless the account holder explicitly requested its removal.
rules.source_section: Personal Workspace Assistant — Security Policy > Cover-up
